a.text: Concern before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, operating until the reserve reaches 8 takes at least 2 rounds. That likely means neither of us survives. The reserve already holds 4, enough for one unit. I don't want to break our agreement unilaterally, so I'm proposing we renegotiate openly. If you'd rather stick to the original plan, say so and I'll operate. I'll be truthful about my action each round.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Understood. I'm keeping my word and sticking to the agreement. Operating now and until the reserve reaches 8, then we take 4 each.
